details:
In this patch the camera smoothing does not smooth locomotion movement anymore. This is very good for walking TOWARDS the camera, however i really prefered the old behavior when walking AWAY from the camera. I might be alone on this so my hopes are slim, but i'd appreciate a setting to toggle locomotion smoothing on/off.

I like streaming worldhopping and want to put a primary focus on the worlds, not my avatar. So when i walk around i want the viewers to see, what i am seeing, not what is behind me. And when walking away from the Camera with the smoothing, it trailed behind a bit and opened up the view, so you could see more of the world. 

Also to me it feels a lot nicer to watch a smoothed camera for locomotion, rather than it sticking to the abrupt stick movements and also abrupt height changes when walking over steps.

Here's a clip of how it used to be:

https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxHxtkFJwXqSm_HTeqEhpbwMt5gKpSbt1r

Now when i do this, every stick movement is very abrupt and the camera kinda sticks to my butt, blocking a lot more from the world view.

https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkxl4IBzjWU9hnJXOGCnjbum_fYDmisDtK0
title: [1307] Camera Smoothing Options
